title: Single treatment not showing up in AAPSClient
body:
The bolus calculator was used on my son's phone at 10:55 local time. My own phone running AAPSClient was in an area with poor cell coverage at the time, but never received the backfilled treatment when connection was restored.

NSV3 on both devices
Web sockets enabled
Treatment did show up in Nightscout

I run a personal fork of AutoISF, but I don't believe that is related to this issue. If that prevents the issue from being investigated though I understand.  AAPSClient 3.2.0.4+autoISF3.0.1, Build aef96efa0c-2024.06.19

Log file attached
[AndroidAPS._2024-08-21_19-00-00_.790.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16719004/AndroidAPS._2024-08-21_19-00-00_.790.zip)
